text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's yours, mine, and everyone's 
Arima Kinen! The year-end all-star race is 
about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Who will seize the dream—who will show us 
the dream?! Just which Umamusume will it 
be...?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Could you give us your thoughts and 
enthusiasm for your final domestic race, 
the Arima Kinen?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! 
Japan's Orfevre is charging ahead---! 
--Orfevre takes the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"200 meters to glory! Orfevre in the lead! 
Orfevre in the lead! But— Here comes a 
challenger on the outside! Can they win on 
the outside—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre... comes in second! Japan's dream 
was overtaken on the final stretch...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ha... So the glory of conquering the realm 
has slipped through my fingers, has it...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ———— ...Kh, kuku...! Khahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. —Aaagh! Unforgivable. —I won't let 
them get away. Never...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
At next year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
I shall part the dark clouds and bestow 
supreme radiance. Accept it with 
reverence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, we shall move our base of 
operations to Europe next year. —Prepare 
yourself mentally. This is a royal decree.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"...E-Excuse me... Orfevre-san? Could you 
share your thoughts on the Arima Kinen――"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: There is an Umamusume named Win Variation.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That creature has kept raising pillars of 
hellfire. It was a fine effort to 
entertain Us.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Yet at the same time, she was an insolent 
rogue who trampled upon supreme authority.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am the "King"— Disrupting my reign is an 
unpardonable barbarism.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...I grant no forgiveness. Therefore, I 
shall demonstrate one thing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I will cross over to Europe, prepare 
everything to perfection— and without 
fail, reclaim the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
And so, with this radiant brilliance, I 
shall paint over every single pillar of 
hellfire that wretch conjures... All of 
it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—S-So, unless it's a radiance brilliant 
enough to conquer the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, Win Variation's 'flame' won't be 
extinguished...!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Are you saying she's a rival with that 
much influence?!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
......Hmph. No such thing as a "rival" 
exists for me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —However...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to getting on my nerves, 
none can surpass that one."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—*Plop.* The can of juice Win Variation 
was about to open falls from her hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A live broadcast of the press conference 
held at the entrance. I was watching it 
casually, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stunned by the unexpected barrage of 
words, both of them froze in their tracks 
before they knew it. Before either could 
utter a word, the press conference rolled 
right along.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Just like how she trampled the path to 
supremacy—thinking back to the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Right before that, she 
hesitated, contemplating stepping back 
from the front lines for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What a detestable, spineless choice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Speaking of the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
that was the race where Orfe-san wasn't in 
top form, right...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, no need to wait—today. Right here on 
this stage.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Crushing them to dust might be amusing in 
its own right.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I-I was? The reason— Wh-What... Wh-What is 
that supposed to mean...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I mean, wait, no way, I-I—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Did I even exist in her heart...?
choice_data_list:
...If anything, you made them sound like 
an archrival.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...What's that about?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
What, what, what is this...! Nothing like 
this has ever happened before...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"You never even glanced my way before...! 
So why, of all days, did it have to be 
today...?!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, damn it, damn it...! *nnghhhh*...!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry, I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I understand why you'd be flustered... 
But depending on how you look at it, this 
is basically an opportunity handed to us."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a race where everyone was supposed to 
be looking at Orfevre, Win Variation's 
name was on everyone's lips.
choice_data_list:
The crowd's eyes will surely be on the two 
of them.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
choice_data_list: They must be wondering which one will win.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha, haha...! I see, you're so 
right...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Gh, an opportunity like this won't come 
again. This is my first and last big 
chance...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Today's the only chance, I gotta do it. If 
that's how it is, I'll go all out and 
settle this!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer! I'm wide awake now!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...If I struggle and fight with 
everything I've got, the people who matter 
will see it!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll seize the leading role! The cheers, 
the applause, the envy—I'll take it all 
for myself—!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I won't let her step even an inch into my 
shadow...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse is already buzzing with 
anticipation and excitement.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us move forward together, 
overcome together! The Grand Prix, the 
Arima Kinen, has begun—!
